documents.title: Chao Phraya Print invoice quoting no purchase order
documents.demonstrates: There is no PO reference anywhere on this page, and it posts. `critical` is about consequence, not presence: it means a wrong value here pays the wrong amount, not that the field must exist. Whether an order is *required* is business policy, answered by a threshold, and 42,000.00 is under it.

documents.demonstrates: The line items, the subtotal and the VAT all agree on 128,000.00 and 8,960.00. The total should read 136,960.00 and reads 139,660.00. Three relations tie those numbers together, one value breaks all of them, and the others stand - which is how the finding can name the total rather than shrug at the page.

documents.title: Chao Phraya Print invoice against a purchase order that was closed
documents.demonstrates: The block half of the pair, and the only document in the set that no built-in rule objects to. PO-2026-9108 was closed on 2026-06-30; this invoice is dated a month later and bills 21,000.00 against it, which is inside the 21,300.00 that was ordered. Arithmetic, vendor, bank account and amount are all correct. The status is not printed on the invoice and no fixed rule reads it - the agent rule is the only thing in the system that stops this being paid.
